sources.title: New Era Energy & Digital Secures 20-Year, 207 MW PPA with Vistra (press release, 21 September 2026; New Era investor-relations press-release feed)
sources.summary: Release datelined Midland, Texas, 21 September 2026 (PressReleaseId 1794; public detail page /news/news-details/2026/New-Era-Energy--Digital-Secures-20-Year-207-MW-PPA-with-Vistra/default.aspx on investors.newerainfra.ai). New Era Energy & Digital, Inc. (Nasdaq: NUAI) says its subsidiary TCDC PowerCo LLC has entered a 20-year power purchase agreement with Luminant ET Services Company LLC, an affiliate of Vistra Corp., to supply a minimum of 200 MW and up to 207 MW of power for Phase 1 of New Era's Texas Critical Data Center ('TCDC') project from Vistra's 1,180 MW natural gas-fired generating facility in Odessa, Texas, 'which is located immediately adjacent to the TCDC site'; the power is expected to be available to TCDC in Q3 2027. The chief executive is quoted that the land is secured, construction permits are in hand and Phase 1 power is contracted for 20 years. A companion development framework gives Vistra a 5% non-voting interest in the powered portion after delivery begins and rights of first refusal/offer on future power development. The About section describes TCDC as New Era's flagship project, a 493-acre site in the Permian Basin with anticipated capacity scaling to 1.4 GW over time.
sources.date_semantics: Release date 21 September 2026 (PressReleaseDate '09/21/2026 07:00:00' in the feed item; dateline Sept. 21, 2026). The capture is the investor-relations feed response for the newest 2026 release at capture time (pageSize 1, pageNumber 0), pinned by its SHA-256; the human-readable detail page answered HTTP 403 to an automated request and the q4cdn.com PDF host answered robots.txt with HTTP 403, so neither was used. Used as the announced-status observation of the named TCDC project on 21 September 2026. The Q3 2027 power date is a forecast; the PPA megawatts are contracted power supply, not IT load.

sources.title: New Era Energy & Digital Files Q2 2026 Form 10-Q and Announces TCDC Construction Permits (press release, 14 August 2026; New Era investor-relations press-release feed)
sources.summary: Release datelined Midland, Texas, 14 August 2026: construction permits for Texas Critical Data Centers LLC ('TCDC') are 'now in hand'. Listed highlights: received Development Structure and Drive Approach Permits from Ector County; submitted the Phase 1 plat to Ector County and the City of Odessa; received approval of a Notice of Intent with the TCEQ to commence grading and 'intend to begin site grading in the coming weeks'; closed the 54-acre corridor acquisition, so the campus 'now stands at 493 acres'; removed 22 abandoned pipelines across 12 rights-of-way; a final surface waiver is pending from one leasehold operator. A Thunderhead Energy Solutions subsidiary (Phase 2 power partner) filed a TCEQ standard air permit application that would support about 550 MW of Phase 2 capacity (about 757 MW gross for Phases 1 and 2 together); end-tenant negotiations and joint-venture discussions with Stream Data Centers are ongoing.
sources.date_semantics: Release date 14 August 2026 (feed item, pageNumber 1 at capture). Context only: the county permits are not identified by number, date or approved scope, so permitted status is not asserted; grading was a stated intention, and the removal of abandoned pipelines is recorded as context, not as a construction stage. The capture is the feed response for this single release, pinned by SHA-256.
